text: ふむ…　おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…　タイム　イズ　マネー…　…　ときは　かねなりか

structure.jp: おしえテレビを　みる　じかんも　ないとは…
structure.en: to think you don't even have time to watch the Teachy TV...

structure.jp: タイム　イズ　マネー…　…
ときは　かねなりか

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: おしえテレビを　みる　じかん
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb, placed before a thing, describes that thing. おしえテレビを　みる　じかん = 'time to watch the Teachy TV'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは at the end of a trailing-off sentence shows surprise: 'to think that...'. ないとは = 'to think you don't have any'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: なり is an old word for 'is', kept in proverbs. かねなり = 'is money'.
